# TASKS.md — Atomic implementation backlog

**Source plan(s):** `tmp/ready-plans/<NN>-<slug>.md`
**Generated by:** /atomize · YYYY-MM-DD
**Format:** one section per atom, dependency order. `[ ]` = pending, `[x]` = committed, `STALE` = superseded.

---

## Legend

- **id** — `M{milestone}.{n}` (e.g. `M3.4`). Stable; never reused.
- **allowed_files** — implementer may read AND write these. Anything else is forbidden.
- **forbidden_files** — explicit list of nearby files the implementer must NOT touch (catches obvious traps).
- **dependencies** — atom IDs that must be `[x]` before this atom starts.
- **parallelizable** — `true` if this atom shares no mutable file with any sibling at the same dependency depth.
- **acceptance** — what "done" means, in checkable bullets.
- **tests/checks** — exact commands the implementer must run; they must all pass.

---

## [ ] M3.1 — Tauri window config

**dependencies:** (none)
**parallelizable:** true (with M3.2)

**allowed_files:**
- `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs`
- `apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`

**forbidden_files:**
- `apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` (deps come in a separate atom)
- anything under `apps/desktop/src/` (Angular side handled in M3.3+)

**acceptance:**
- [ ] App opens with min-width 900, min-height 600
- [ ] Title bar transparent, theme=dark
- [ ] No console errors on `pnpm dev`

**tests/checks:**
```sh
cargo check -p desktop
pnpm nx lint desktop
# Manual: pnpm dev → window opens with the listed properties
```

**notes:** (left empty by /atomize, filled by implementer if needed)

**commit:** (set by /implement when [x])
